hypotheses.reasoning: payment-svc v1.10.0 was rolled out at 02:16:24 (#1539) and came up with 'response serializer v2 enabled' at 02:16:54 (#1582). Its /charge replies now carry id/state/updatedAt and no 'status' field. order-service cannot map the payload (#1601, #1671, #1755), so checkout orders fail. order-service returns 502 to api-gateway, which surfaces POST /checkout 502s (#1686 and later). Before the deploy, /charge succeeded consistently (e.g. #1580). The account-svc/auth-svc connection refusals and /login 503s are a separate fault and do not explain the checkout 502s. The billing-reconciler checksum errors are also unrelated noise. The order-consumer DLQ event at #630 is a single early message and not the cause.

A separate issue: auth-svc at 10.33.162.6:8081 refuses connections from about 02:14:32, so account-svc token issuance fails and edge-proxy /login returns 503s. This explains login errors, not checkout 502s on order-service, so it is a secondary finding for a different incident path.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll back payment-svc to v1.9.1 (or disable response serializer v2) to restore the 'status' field, then confirm order-service decode errors stop and the checkout 502 rate drops. Replay the failed orders from 02:16:54 onward. Fix the v2 serializer contract, or make order-service tolerant of it, before re-rolling. Separately, investigate auth-svc refusing connections on 10.33.162.6:8081, which is breaking /login.
